useCase: カメラモデル識別、ソース帰属、AIコンテンツ検証
mechanism: 使用します a deep ニューラルネットワーク (DnCNN) to extract the noise residual of an image, は contains the camera-specific ノイズパターン. Authentic photos have consistent noise signatures from the imaging sensor, while AI生成の images show synthetic or absent ノイズパターンs.
accuracy: 高 - 87-95% for distinguishing camera images from AI生成の content
name: ノイズプリント分析
parameters: Network: DnCNN-17 layers, Patch size: 64x64, Stride: 32, Correlation metric: normalized cross-相関
description: 抽出します and 分析する the camera sensor ノイズパターン (noiseprint) embedded画像内の. AI生成の images lack authentic sensor noise signatures.

references.title: Cozzolino, D. & Verdoliva, L. (2020). Noiseprint: A CNN-Based Camera Model Fingerprint. IEEE TIFS.
Mandelli, S. et al. (2020). CNN-Based Fast Source Device Identification. IEEE SPL.

strengths:
• Very high 精度 for camera vs AI distinction
• Captures camera-specific noise fingerprint
• Deep learning enhances noise extraction
• Robust to moderate post-processing
limitations:
• Requires trained DnCNN model
• Heavy denoising destroys ノイズパターンs
• Social media compression degrades 精度
• New camera models may not be in training data
